<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2103-23-12" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang chub skyabs</rs> ni <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign>'i mtshan nyid phyogs chos dang khyab pa yin no ||
         khyab pa de yang rjes 'gro ldog pa'i khyab pa thun mong ste dper na kha tog tsam po zhes bya ba de sngon po dang ser po gnyis ka la yod pa bzhin no ||
         des na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnam 'grel</rs> nas <quote source="db:3772" n="1.1">
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">phyogs chos de chas khyab pa ni |</l>
            <l xml:space="preserve"><foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> de ni rnam gsum ste ||</l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">med na mi 'byung nges phyir ro ||</l>
            <l xml:space="preserve"><foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> ltar snang de las gzhan ||</l>
         </lg></quote>
         zhes bshad pas so zhes gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
